definitions.explanation: An individual drop of rain. Used in both everyday descriptions of weather and in more literary or poetic contexts.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{雨粒|あまつぶ}が{落|お}ちてきた。
{窓|まど}ガラスに{雨粒|あまつぶ}がついている。
examples.english: There are raindrops on the window glass.

examples.japanese: {雨粒|あまつぶ}が{葉|は}っぱの{上|うえ}でキラキラと{光|ひか}っていた。
examples.english: Raindrops were glistening on the leaves.

notes:
Composed of {雨|あま} (rain, combining form) + {粒|つぶ} (grain, drop). Note that {雨|あめ} changes to {雨|あま} in compounds. The word {粒|つぶ} is a versatile suffix for small round objects.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|おお}きな{雨粒|あまつぶ}: large raindrops
- {雨粒|あまつぶ}が{落|お}ちる: raindrops fall
- {雨粒|あまつぶ}が{当|あ}たる: raindrops hit

RELATED WORDS WITH 〜{粒|つぶ}:
- {涙粒|なみだつぶ}: teardrop
- {汗粒|あせつぶ}: bead of sweat
- {水粒|みずつぶ}: water droplet
